mentions.name: CrashGuard
mentions.description: Self-hosted open source system for monitoring and alerting on stalled, crashed, or overdue asynchronous workflows. Includes a Stream Deck plugin that surfaces workflow status on the Stream Deck XL and, when a button goes red, opens the admin portal to the failed workflow.
mentions.problem: Monitoring odd asynchronous workflows through log analysis was a pain, so this provides dedicated monitoring and alerting instead.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a self-hosted open source system for monitoring and alerting on stalled / crashed / overdue asynchronous workflows. I had some weird things I needed to monitor and log analysis was kind of a PITA for dealing with them so I built this instead
mentions.author: felix-the-cat
